from fastapi import FastAPI, Depends, HTTPException, Request
from fastapi.responses import HTMLResponse, FileResponse
from fastapi.staticfiles import StaticFiles
from fastapi.middleware.cors import CORSMiddleware
from starlette.middleware.base import BaseHTTPMiddleware
from services.db import connect
from startup import PassthroughAuth
from routers import overview, accounts, imports, entities, investments, debt, tracker, learning

app = FastAPI()

# Middleware for CORS
app.add_middleware(
    CORSMiddleware,
    allow_origins=["*"],
    allow_credentials=True,
    allow_methods=["*"],
    allow_headers=["*"],
)

# Middleware for handling state
class StateMiddleware(BaseHTTPMiddleware):
    async def dispatch(self, request: Request, call_next):
        request.state.db = await connect()
        response = await call_next(request)
        request.state.db.close()
        return response

app.add_middleware(StateMiddleware)

# Mount static files
if "static" in app.mounts:
    app.mount("/", StaticFiles(directory="static", html=True), name="static")

# Catch-all route for deep links
@app.get("/{full_path:path}", response_class=HTMLResponse)
async def catch_all(request: Request, full_path: str):
    file_path = f"static/{full_path}.html"
    if request.method == "HEAD":
        return FileResponse(file_path, status_code=200)
    try:
        return FileResponse(file_path)
    except FileNotFoundError:
        file_path = f"static/{full_path}/index.html"
        try:
            return FileResponse(file_path)
        except FileNotFoundError:
            return FileResponse("static/index.html")

# Health check
@app.get("/api/finance/health")
async def health_check():
    return {"status": "ok"}

# Routers
app.include_router(overview.router, prefix="/api/finance")
app.include_router(accounts.router, prefix="/api/finance")
app.include_router(imports.router, prefix="/api/finance")
app.include_router(entities.router, prefix="/api/finance")
app.include_router(investments.router, prefix="/api/finance")
app.include_router(debt.router, prefix="/api/finance")
app.include_router(tracker.router, prefix="/api/finance")
app.include_router(learning.router, prefix="/api/finance")
